errors.error_description: Drove an input port using a continuous assignment: assign wr_en = rd_en; which violates port directionality and variable driving rules.
Introduced an unintentional latch by omitting the default assignment for wr_ptr_n and only assigning it inside an if branch.
Used 4-state case equality (===) in synthesizable RTL for empty flag computation, which is unsafe for synthesis.
Created sequential logic clocked by the reset signal using always @(posedge rst_n), inferring a flip-flop without a proper clock.
